title: Gintama. Shirogane no Tamashii-hen
synopsis:
After the fierce battle on Rakuyou, the untold past and true goal of the immortal Naraku leader, Utsuro, are finally revealed. By corrupting the Altana reserves of several planets, Utsuro has successfully triggered the intervention of the Tendoshuu’s greatest enemy: the Altana Liberation Army. With Earth as the main battleground in this interplanetary war, Utsuro's master plan to destroy the planet—and himself—is nearly complete. 

An attack on the O-Edo Central Terminal marks the beginning of the final battle to take back the land of the samurai. With the Yorozuya nowhere in sight, the bakufu all but collapsed, and the Shogun missing, the people are left completely helpless as the Liberation Army begins pillaging Edo in the name of freeing them from the Tendoshuu's rule. 

Caught in the crossfire between two equally imposing forces, can Gintoki, Kagura, Shinpachi, and the former students of Shouyou Yoshida put aside their differences and unite their allies to protect what they hold dear?

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

episodes_data.title: The Stairs to Adulthood May Not Always Lead Up
episodes_data.description: Umibozu drops in to visit Kagura, but he and Gintoki get the shock of their lives when Kagura reveals she has a boyfriend now.
episodes_data.title_es: Es posible que las escaleras hacia la edad adulta no siempre conduzcan hacia arriba

episodes_data.title: My Bald Dad, My Light-Haired Dad, and My Dad's Glasses
episodes_data.description: Umibozu and Gintoki`s meeting with Kagura`s boyfriend Dai doesn`t go according to plan as he`s revealed to be the prince of Planet Titan. Meanwhile, the new couple`s relationship takes a drastic turn.
episodes_data.title_es: Mi papá calvo, mi papá rubio y las gafas de mi papá

episodes_data.title: A Bowl of Ramen
episodes_data.description: Katsura, upon hearing Ikumatsu`s story about an old man who used to visit her restaurant every New Year`s Eve, enlists the Odd Jobs` help to look for him.
episodes_data.title_es: Un plato de ramen

episodes_data.title: A Family
episodes_data.description: The gang discover the truth behind the old man and look to reunite him with Ikumatsu and her ramen.
episodes_data.title_es: Una familia

episodes_data.title: Life, Death, and Shades / All the Answers Can Be Found in the Field
episodes_data.description: Hasegawa has a life-or-death encounter with assassins, and the Shinsengumi and Mimawarigumi compete over solving a fictional case.
episodes_data.title_es: Vida, muerte y sombras / Todas las respuestas se pueden encontrar en el campo

episodes_data.title: 3000 Leagues in Search of a Scabbard
episodes_data.description: The Odd Jobs encounter a strange sword at Tetsuko`s smithy, and it grows attached (quite literally) to Gintoki`s behind!
episodes_data.title_es: 3000 Leguas en busca de una vaina

episodes_data.title: The Super Sadist and the Super Sadist
episodes_data.description: Kusanagi reveals the details of an old wound he received at the hands of the cursed sword, Maganagi, as Gintoki and Okita get ready for their duel. Meanwhile, Hijikata investigates Senbe the Manslayer.
episodes_data.title_es: El Súper Sádico y el Súper Sádico

episodes_data.title: The Strongest Sword, and the Dullest Sword
episodes_data.description: The Excaliburling story reaches its climax as Maganagi takes over Okita`s body and reveals the truth to Kusanagi. How will Gintoki respond?
episodes_data.title_es: La espada más fuerte y la espada más desafilada

episodes_data.title: Wash Your Hands Before a Handshake
episodes_data.description: As group units take over the idol industry, Terakado Tsu must adapt or fall behind the times. But the idol she forms a combo unit with is... Kagura?
episodes_data.title_es: Lávese las manos antes de dar un apretón de manos

episodes_data.title: Diamonds Are Unscratchable
episodes_data.description: Boogie Diamonds 48 has to deal with the sudden arrival of Galaxy Kingdom Bitches 48, who challenge them for the spot of Edo`s top idol!
episodes_data.title_es: Los diamantes son irrompibles

episodes_data.title: An Idol's Badge of Honor
episodes_data.description: The battle at the Oedo Dome heats up as the fans waver between the two groups, but Otsu is still holed up indoors. Will she fade away, or will Shinpachi and gang rekindle her passion?
episodes_data.title_es: La insignia de honor de un ídolo

episodes_data.title: The Line Between Godlike Games and Shitty Games Is Paper-Thin / Glasses Are a Part of the Soul
episodes_data.description: In the first half, Gintoki decides that as protagonist, he can`t sit and do nothing as a Gintama game is released. He takes matters into his own hands as Odd Jobs looks to produce a superhit. In the second, Shinpachi buys a new pair of glasses that get him rather high spirits...
episodes_data.title_es: La línea entre los juegos divinos y los juegos de mierda es muy fina / Las gafas son parte del alma

episodes_data.title: Guardian Spirits Are Also a Part of the Soul
episodes_data.description: The Kabuki District Sports Meet begins, and Shinpachi bears witness to the influence guardian spirits have on such events. Will he be able to fight through it and help Odd Jobs win the cash prize?
episodes_data.title_es: Los espíritus guardianes también son parte del alma

episodes_data.title: Try As You Might to Make a Natural Perm Go Away, It Will Always Return
episodes_data.description: Utsuro`s master plan is in full effect as Earth is taken over by the Altana Liberation Army. With Odd Jobs still not back from Rakuyo, the residents of Kabuki District have a hard time adjusting to life as a colony.
episodes_data.title_es: Por más que intentes hacer que una permanente natural desaparezca, siempre volverá

episodes_data.title: Flavoring Is Best in Small Quantities
episodes_data.description: Katsura, Sakamoto, and Nobunobu arrive at the S.S. Heavenly Bird and try to bring the Liberation Army to the negotiating table. Meanwhile, the various factions in Edo begin to make their move.
episodes_data.title_es: El saborizante es mejor en pequeñas cantidades

episodes_data.title: A Delinquent's Kid Has Long Neck Hair
episodes_data.description: With the Odd Jobs looking for the Tendoshu, things heat up on the Liberation Army`s main ship. Shijaku has promised his cooperation to Nobunobu, but now he must convince his comrades.
episodes_data.title_es: El hijo de un delincuente tiene el pelo largo en el cuello

episodes_data.title: The Line Between Tenacious and Annoying Is Paper-Thin
episodes_data.description: The encounter with Utsuro leaves Gintoki feeling more helpless than ever before. That`s when he receives a very powerful reminder.
episodes_data.title_es: La línea entre tenaz y molesto es muy fina

episodes_data.title: Geezers Carve the Things They Shouldn't Forget into Their Wrinkles
episodes_data.description: The return of some familiar faces breathes new life into Earth`s resistance, but they`re as troublesome as they`ve always been! And when the Liberation Army brings out its big guns, it`s up to Gengai to respond.
episodes_data.title_es: Los viejos tallan en sus arrugas las cosas que no deberían olvidar

episodes_data.title: Machines That Pick Up Useless Habits Are Called People
episodes_data.description: The machines have done their part and left Earth`s future in the hands of humanity. But Gengai`s cannon has also painted a huge target on the Kabuki Distruct, and the Liberation Army immediately marches toward it.
episodes_data.title_es: Las máquinas que adquieren hábitos inútiles se llaman personas

episodes_data.title: Men Must Live Not Long nor Thick, but Hard
episodes_data.description: Prince Hata`s past is revealed along with the history of Planet Okoku. Can Katsura and Hasegawa really get them on Earth`s side?
episodes_data.title_es: Los hombres no deben vivir mucho ni mucho, sino duro

episodes_data.title: Ogres Are Weak Against Tiny Heroes Like the Inch-High Samurai
episodes_data.description: The Kabuki District is under siege, and the fearsome Dakini race arrive on the scene. How can the District and its residents cope with this onslaught?
episodes_data.title_es: Los ogros son débiles contra héroes pequeños como el samurái de una pulgada de alto

episodes_data.title: Bragging About Your Own Heroic Deeds Will Make People Hate You, So Make Others Do It for You
episodes_data.description: The Shinra finally make their move and look to capture the creator of the virus cannon with their underhand tactics. But right as things get desperate, the "boss" of the Kabuki District intervenes.
episodes_data.title_es: Alardear de tus propios actos heroicos hará que la gente te odie, así que haz que otros lo hagan por ti

episodes_data.title: Jump and Power Creep Go Hand-in-Hand
episodes_data.description: Under the leadership of the Kabuki District`s Four Devas, the residents are beginning to drive out the enemies inside the town. However, they still have to deal with Ougai, the leader of the Dakini force.
episodes_data.title_es: El salto y el power creep van de la mano

episodes_data.title: Peace and Destruction Are Two Sides of the Same Coin
episodes_data.description: After successfully driving the Liberation Army out of the Kabuki District, its residents enjoy a well-earned break. However, they know that the peace won`t last for long.
episodes_data.title_es: La paz y la destrucción son dos caras de la misma moneda

episodes_data.title: Bushido Is Found One Second Before Death
episodes_data.description: Gengai has gone missing, and Ensho has brought out his trump card. How can the Odd Jobs, the Shinsengumi, Katsura, Sakamoto, and Nobunobu get out of this desperate situation?
episodes_data.title_es: Bushido se encuentra un segundo antes de la muerte

synopsis_es:
Después de la feroz batalla en Rakuyou, finalmente se revela el pasado no contado y el verdadero objetivo del inmortal líder Naraku, Utsuro. Al corromper las reservas de Altana de varios planetas, Utsuro ha provocado con éxito la intervención del mayor enemigo del Tendoshuu: el Ejército de Liberación de Altana. Con la Tierra como principal campo de batalla en esta guerra interplanetaria, el plan maestro de Utsuro para destruir el planeta (y a él mismo) está casi completo. 

Un ataque a la terminal central de O-Edo marca el comienzo de la batalla final para recuperar la tierra de los samuráis. Sin el Yorozuya a la vista, el bakufu casi colapsado y el Shogun desaparecido, la gente queda completamente indefensa cuando el Ejército de Liberación comienza a saquear Edo en nombre de liberarlos del dominio del Tendoshuu. 

Atrapados en el fuego cruzado entre dos fuerzas igualmente imponentes, ¿podrán Gintoki, Kagura, Shinpachi y los antiguos alumnos de Shouyou Yoshida dejar de lado sus diferencias y unir a sus aliados para proteger lo que más aprecian?

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]
